payload.reason: The evidence provides clear methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation through section title embeddings and classified section title embeddings.

claims.text: Section titles are encoded using section title embeddings (STE) by feeding tokenized titles into a TLM and summing the last hidden states.
Classified section title embeddings replace intraclass STEs with the embedding of their corresponding class, defined by typical section title classes.
The method groups similar section titles into classes, enhancing the encoding process by treating semantically similar titles as equivalent.
